english.title: People's War
english.description:
Requires the Gathering Storm ruleset. Applies to human and AI major civilizations and city-states. Starting at 1 population, gain +1 normal and religious combat strength per 10 total population, capped at +100.
Each city gains +1 ranged strike and +1 outer defense at 2 population and every 2 population thereafter, capped at +50 each at 100 population. Starting at 1 population, each city gains 1 counter-spy level per 5 population, capped at +20 at 96 population.
Conquered cities lose no population.

schinese.title: 人民战争
schinese.description:
仅适用于风云变幻规则集。效果适用于人类主要文明、AI主要文明和城邦。帝国总人口从1人口起每10人口获得+1普通与宗教战斗力，最高+100。
单城每满2人口获得+1远程攻击和+1外防御，100人口时各封顶+50。反间谍从1人口起每5人口增加1级，96人口时封顶+20级。
征服城市人口不会损失。
